name: Iskus hrabrosti
source: The protagonist and his father move to a new house on the outskirts of a small town. But this place turns out to be cursed, and the locals are bewitched. The only way to break the curse is to muster courage and bend this new reality to your will.
translation: 主角和他的父亲搬到了小镇郊区的一所新房子。但这个地方原来被诅咒了，当地人都被迷住了。打破诅咒的唯一方法就是鼓起勇气，让这个新的现实屈服于你的意志。
